resources.string: Open from AnkiDroid with a link like:\nankientapi://x-callback-url?q=your_vocab
LLM not configured — showing local mnemonic stories when available.
LLM unavailable — showing local mnemonic stories.
Providers are tried in order. If one does not respond, the next is used. Each provider has its own base URL, token, and model list.

Supported placeholders (case-sensitive):
{QUERY} — exact vocabulary from the deep link
{OPPOSITE} — simplified/traditional variants per unique Han character
{SIMPL_HISTORY} — simplification notes (source-backed vs derived)
{MNEMO_EXAMPLES} — up to five mnemonic stories per Han compound or character (compounds first)
{SEMANTIC} — semantic component for pictophonetic characters
{PHONETIC} — phonetic component for pictophonetic characters

Multi-character queries: metadata placeholders list each distinct Han character in first-occurrence order (max 20). {MNEMO_EXAMPLES} also looks up contiguous compound words. Non-Han characters are ignored for metadata but kept in {QUERY}. Unknown {PLACEHOLDERS} are left unchanged and warned about; saving is still allowed.
